messages.content: Great! I'm excited to talk with you about enhancing the university student portal. To start, could you share with me the high-level goals you have in mind for these enhancements? What do you hope to achieve with the personalised timetable, grade notifications, and module feedback system?

Yeah, so, I just really want the timetable to be easier to read and use. It's kind of a mess right now, and I feel like if I could make it more personal, like using colors or something, it would help a lot. 

Also, getting notified when grades come out would be super helpful. I don't want to have to keep checking all the time; it would be nice to just get a heads-up when something's posted.

And then the feedback thing — I think it would be good to have a way to share thoughts on the modules after they're done, you know? Just to make sure things are getting better each year. So, those are the main things I’m looking for!

Thanks for sharing your thoughts! It sounds like you have some clear ideas about what you want for the portal enhancements. 

Let’s dive a little deeper into each of those areas. Starting with the personalised timetable, you mentioned using colors to improve readability. Can you tell me more about what specific features you would like to see? For example, what kind of personalisation do you envision beyond just color?

Yeah, I mean, the colors would definitely help me keep track of things better. But I think it would also be great if I could hide any classes that get canceled, like, if they’re not happening, I don’t want to see them anymore. 

And maybe having some blocks for my own study time would be cool too, just to plan things out better. So, like, being able to add my own stuff to the timetable would make it way easier to manage everything.

Those are excellent suggestions! So if I understand correctly, you would like the personalised timetable to include features for color coding, the ability to hide canceled classes, and the option to add your own study blocks. 

Now, regarding the automated grade notifications, could you elaborate on how you would like to receive those notifications? For instance, do you prefer email alerts, push notifications on your phone, or something else? Also, would you like to be notified for specific types of updates, like grades only or any new announcements related to your modules?

Yeah, I think getting notifications on my phone would be the best. Like, a push notification would be super convenient since I usually have my phone with me. 

As for what I'd want to be notified about, definitely just when grades come out. I don’t need a ton of other announcements, just the important stuff like grades, you know? That way, I can just focus on what really matters.

Great! So you’d like to receive push notifications on your phone specifically for grade updates when they are posted, without being overwhelmed by other announcements. That makes a lot of sense.

Now, let’s talk about the structured module feedback system. Can you describe how you envision providing feedback on the modules? For example, what kind of feedback are you thinking of — would it be a simple rating, open comments, or a mix of both? And how would you like to access this feedback system? Would you prefer it to be available at the end of each module or at a specific time each semester?

I think a mix of both would work best. Like, a simple rating system for things, but then also a space for comments where I can explain my thoughts a bit more. That way, I can say what I liked or didn’t like about the module.

As for when to access it, I’d prefer it to be available at the end of each module. It just makes sense to give feedback right after it’s done, you know? That way I can remember everything better and share what I really think.

That sounds like a solid approach! To summarize, you envision the module feedback system to have a mix of a simple rating system and a comment section for more detailed feedback. You would like this feedback option to be available at the end of each module so that you can provide your thoughts while everything is still fresh in your mind.

So far, we have:

1. Personalised timetable features: color coding, hiding canceled classes, and adding personal study blocks.
2. Automated grade notifications via push notifications on your phone for grade updates only.
3. Structured module feedback system with a rating and comment option, accessible at the end of each module.

Before we wrap up, are there any limitations or restrictions you think we should consider for these enhancements? For example, are there any technical constraints or privacy concerns we should be aware of?

Honestly, I haven't really thought about any technical stuff or privacy concerns. I just want things to work smoothly and be easy to use. I guess it would be important to make sure my data is safe, but I'm not sure what that means in terms of specifics. 

I just want to focus on the features that make everything better for students like me. So, if there are any limits, I’d leave that to the tech people to figure out!

That’s completely understandable! It’s important to focus on the features that enhance the student experience. So, just to confirm, you want the enhancements to be user-friendly and effective, while also ensuring that data security is a priority — but you’re leaving the technical details and constraints to the tech team to handle.

With all that information in mind, here’s a recap of the requirements we've gathered:

1. Personalised timetable features: color coding, hiding canceled classes, and adding personal study blocks.
2. Automated grade notifications via push notifications on your phone for grade updates only.
3. Structured module feedback system with a rating and comment option, accessible at the end of each module.
4. A general focus on user-friendly design and data security without specific technical constraints defined by users.

Is there anything else you would like to add? If not, I think we have a solid list of requirements!
No, I think that covers everything I wanted to mention! I’m really glad we could talk about this. Just hoping these changes can make things easier for all of us students. Thanks for listening!

You're very welcome! I'm glad we could discuss your ideas and gather your requirements. I appreciate your insights, and I share your hope that these enhancements will greatly improve the experience for students. 

REQUIREMENTS_COMPLETE
